semantic_findings.title: Overstated Water Purification Claims
semantic_findings.description: The fictional script says boiling for ten minutes can kill any microorganism and that a purification tablet handles remaining chemical threats. These broad claims could be unsafe if treated as real survival advice.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The prose explicitly presents universal purification outcomes and labels the methods scientifically accurate. Real water safety depends on contaminants, equipment, and local guidance.

content.value_statement: Water shortages create urgent choices in survival stories. This skill guides a science-fiction chapter with testing, purification, exploration, and character growth.
actual_capabilities: Presents a five-stage Water Crisis chapter for an interactive roleplay.
Offers nearby collection and distant-expedition story routes.
Guides fictional water analysis, filtration, boiling, and purification scenes.
Introduces alien ecology discoveries and escalating exploration stakes.
Provides three ending directions for scientific, adventurous, or survival-focused play.
limitations: This is a fictional narrative guide, not real water-safety or survival advice.
It focuses on one chapter and does not provide a full campaign system.
The source material is primarily Chinese with some English phrases.
Scientific details are simplified for storytelling and may not apply in real conditions.

use_cases.title: Run a survival roleplay scene
use_cases.description: Lead a player through urgent water choices and their narrative consequences.

use_cases.title: Draft a science-fiction chapter
use_cases.description: Use the staged structure to write a tense survival sequence with scientific discovery.

use_cases.title: Build alien-world lore
use_cases.description: Expand a planet setting through water chemistry, ecology, and new species.

prompt_templates.title: Start the chapter
prompt_templates.prompt: Start the Water Crisis chapter. Present Stella’s water shortage and ask me to choose a nearby source or the distant signal.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a safe route
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the nearby-water route. Keep the tone tense and explain Stella’s fictional test results before asking for my next choice.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate the stream
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the expedition route to the purple stream. Include an alien organism discovery, competing purification options, and one meaningful risk.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt the chapter
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt the Water Crisis chapter for my original astronaut character and planet. Preserve the five-stage arc, add two branching consequences, and avoid presenting fictional treatment as real safety advice.

output_examples.input: Start the Water Crisis chapter and show the first decision.
output: Stella reports that only 300 ml of water remains.
She identifies dew, pooled water, fruit juice, and a distant scanner signal.
The response asks the player to choose a cautious local search or a demanding expedition.
Stella prepares containers, a filter, an analyzer, and emergency supplies.
The journey reveals a purple stream containing an unknown organism.
The response asks the player to select a fictional testing or purification approach.

best_practices: State that the chapter is fictional before discussing water treatment.
Ask for a player decision at each major stage.
Use test results and consequences to make choices meaningful.
anti_patterns: Do not present fictional purification outcomes as real medical or survival guidance.
Do not remove uncertainty from every scientific discovery.
Do not force a single route when the player makes a valid choice.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides a structured interactive-fiction chapter about an astronaut facing a water shortage.

faq.question: Is this real water purification guidance?
faq.answer: No. It is fictional storytelling material and must not replace local public-health or survival guidance.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Can I use another main character?
faq.answer: Yes. Replace Stella with your character while keeping the survival choices and chapter structure.

faq.question: Does it support branching play?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes local collection, a distant expedition, purification choices, and several ending directions.

faq.question: What language is the source material?
faq.answer: The source is primarily Chinese and includes English phrases in its dialogue and headings.
